## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D rugby game for phones and tablets, with cinematic gameplay, alternating attack and defense, tackles, stamina and power, and replays.

## Requirements
- Include running, dodging, stepping, spinning, jumping, passing, big/flying/illegal tackles, shoulder charges, slow-motion and X-ray-style replays, and a highlight reel.
- Add realistic NPC players, visible stamina/power with fatigue and recovery, and high-definition visuals with defined faces and bodies.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finished.

- Use Vite and Three.js; create players and stadium procedurally without external models.

- Added a procedural Three.js game foundation, controls, gameplay loop, AI, scoring, possession changes, and replay/highlight UI in `src/main.js`.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js scene, player models, game state, controls, AI, actions, and gameplay loop.
- `index.html`: Game interface, start/result overlays, replay screen, and mobile controls.
- `src/style.css`: UI styling and responsive layouts.
